annotations.text:
Every artboard has a light/dark switch in the tweak row above it.

One accent, two tokens: #e1ab76 is a FILL only (2.04:1 on white). #895420 is the readable half, used for links, the keyword mark, the nav underline and the focus ring.
No shadow token exists. Surfaces are separated by a 1px border or a sunken fill. Nothing dims by opacity — rows, disabled buttons and the dispatch page all set a colour instead.
